lines.text: I replayed this song twenty times!
I'm obsessed with this new song.

data.define: Used when you love something very much.

example.text: I'm obsessed with this new song.

misuse.text: Don't tell a coworker you're 'obsessed' with her.
misuse.why: It can sound creepy, not friendly.

hook.text: I replayed this song twenty times!

publish.title: What does "obsessed" mean?
publish.value: Obsessed = Loving something a lot. Example: "I'm obsessed with this new song." (casual English).
